authority: 工资支付暂行规定 第十一条至第十二条; 人力资源社会保障部《关于职工全年月平均工作时间和工资折算问题的通知》(人社部发〔2025〕2号, 自2025年1月1日): 月计薪天数 (365 − 104) ÷ 12 = 21.75 天; 日工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ 21.75; 小时工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ (21.75 × 8); 年工作日 248 天, 季 62 天, 月 20.67 天 https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202501/content_6995777.htm (it replaced 劳社部发〔2008〕3号). The engine apportions a leave row to each period it overlaps (by the WORK days it covers, or calendar days without a shift plan). Each covered working day is deducted at the daily wage; a period whose working days are all covered deducts the whole salary of the period, so a fund-paid maternity month pays nothing and never goes negative. Without a shift plan the calendar days convert at 21.75 ÷ the month's days. A settlement part (semi-monthly, ten-day) deducts at most its own share of the month (21.75 ÷ parts days).

name: Untaken annual leave pay (未休年休假工资报酬)
authority: 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 第十条、第十一条: 300% of the daily wage, which includes the normal wage already paid, so the further 200% is paid; 第十一条: 日工资收入 = 月工资 ÷ 21.75, 月工资 = 支付前12个月剔除加班工资后的月平均工资 (不满12个月按实际月份) — `earned.months[]` gross less the overtime lines; without earlier months the contract base. 人力资源社会保障部《关于职工全年月平均工作时间和工资折算问题的通知》(人社部发〔2025〕2号, 自2025年1月1日): 月计薪天数 (365 − 104) ÷ 12 = 21.75 天; 日工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ 21.75; 小时工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ (21.75 × 8); 年工作日 248 天, 季 62 天, 月 20.67 天 https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202501/content_6995777.htm (it replaced 劳社部发〔2008〕3号).
rate: 2.0 * (size(earned.months) > 0 ? sum(earned.months.map(m, m.gross - ((has(m.OVERTIME) ? m.OVERTIME : 0.0) + (has(m.REST_DAY_WORK) ? m.REST_DAY_WORK : 0.0) + (has(m.HOLIDAY_WORK) ? m.HOLIDAY_WORK : 0.0) + (has(m.COMPREHENSIVE_OVERTIME) ? m.COMPREHENSIVE_OVERTIME : 0.0)))) / double(size(earned.months)) : terms.base_salary) / 21.75

name: Reduced leave pay (病假、产前假、哺乳假等折扣工资)
authority: The unpaid part of a leave day paid at a fraction: SICK_LEAVE (沪劳保发〔1995〕83号 scale; 80% of the minimum wage floor), PRENATAL_LEAVE and NURSING_LEAVE (80%, 上海市女职工劳动保护办法 第十八条) and STOPPAGE_NOT_EMPLOYEE_FAULT after the first pay cycle. 人力资源社会保障部《关于职工全年月平均工作时间和工资折算问题的通知》(人社部发〔2025〕2号, 自2025年1月1日): 月计薪天数 (365 − 104) ÷ 12 = 21.75 天; 日工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ 21.75; 小时工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ (21.75 × 8); 年工作日 248 天, 季 62 天, 月 20.67 天 https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202501/content_6995777.htm (it replaced 劳社部发〔2008〕3号). The day rate is the post's normal monthly wage with its fixed allowances (the overtime base; SH at least the minimum wage) ÷ 21.75: 上海市企业工资支付办法 第九条 sets one base for 加班工资和假期工资, 病假 among the 假期.
eligibility: (sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && !r.is_npl && r.pay_fraction > 0.0 && r.pay_fraction < 1.0).map(r, (1.0 - r.pay_fraction) * r.days)) * (double(period.covered_working_days) > 0.0 ? 1.0 : 21.75 / double(period.month_days))) > 0.0
quantity: sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && !r.is_npl && r.pay_fraction > 0.0 && r.pay_fraction < 1.0).map(r, (1.0 - r.pay_fraction) * r.days)) * (double(period.covered_working_days) > 0.0 ? 1.0 : 21.75 / double(period.month_days))
rate: (company.region in rules.regions.by_region) ? ((((rules.regions.by_region[company.region].wage_base_floor_minimum_wage ? max(terms.base_salary + sum(terms.allowances.filter(a, a.code in ["FIXED_ALLOWANCE", "FOREIGN_LANGUAGE_ALLOWANCE", "FOREIGN_CHILD_EDUCATION_ALLOWANCE"]).map(a, double(a.amount))), (double(rules.regions.by_region[company.region].minimum_wage.zones[(has(company.facts.wage_zone) ? string(company.facts.wage_zone) : rules.regions.by_region[company.region].minimum_wage.default_zone)].amount))) : terms.base_salary + sum(terms.allowances.filter(a, a.code in ["FIXED_ALLOWANCE", "FOREIGN_LANGUAGE_ALLOWANCE", "FOREIGN_CHILD_EDUCATION_ALLOWANCE"]).map(a, double(a.amount))))) / 21.75)) : 0.0

name: Work-suspension pay reduction (停工停产工资差额)
authority: Each suspended WORK day pays its kind's `pay` (suspension_kind) in place of the daily wage (monthly ÷ 21.75, 人社部发〔2025〕2号): the line deducts the difference. 工资支付暂行规定 第十二条: 非因劳动者原因造成单位停工、停产在一个工资支付周期内的, 应按劳动合同规定的标准支付工资; 超过一个工资支付周期的, 若劳动者提供了正常劳动, 支付的劳动报酬不得低于当地的最低工资标准; 若没有提供正常劳动, 应按国家有关规定办理. 人社厅明电〔2020〕5号 二 https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-01/27/content_5472508.htm: 职工没有提供正常劳动的, 企业应当发放生活费, 生活费标准按各省、自治区、直辖市规定的办法执行. SH: 沪人社规〔2026〕10号 十二 https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/cmsres/ee/ee4c819d093644fe9dbd470d2aa0d1dd/3bf28e8da2b7faa5c9fc6359be7780fc.pdf. The first cycle runs a month from the suspension's first day (`suspension.from`, across pay periods); after it the suspension fact `agreed_daily_pay` is the new agreement. A later day not worked pays the living allowance (生活费), the suspension fact `living_allowance_daily`, else nothing: neither city sets a statutory amount. KM: 云南省人力资源和社会保障厅《关于新型冠状病毒感染的肺炎疫情防控期间劳动关系的政策解答》 四 (on 云人社通〔2020〕12号, 2020-01-31): 超过一个工资支付周期的, 若职工提供了正常劳动, 企业支付给职工的工资按照双方新约定的标准支付, 但不得低于当地最低工资标准. 职工没有提供正常劳动的, 企业按照企业规章制度规定或者集体合同、劳动合同约定的标准发放生活费 (read 2026-10-08 as official reproductions on WeChat: 云南人才市场 2020-02-07 “来源于云南人力资源和社会保障网”, with the notice scan; 云视新闻七彩云 2020-02-05; 918云南交通台 2020-02-05 from 云南发布; all verbatim). The notice itself (三) stops at the minimum wage for days worked; 昆明市工资支付条例 第二十八条 sets no amount. SH: 沪人社规〔2026〕10号 十二 sets none either.
eligibility: sum(work.days.filter(d, d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK").map(d, max(0.0, terms.base_salary / 21.75 - double(d.suspended.pay)))) > 0.0
rate: sum(work.days.filter(d, d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK").map(d, max(0.0, terms.base_salary / 21.75 - double(d.suspended.pay))))
